verses.text: This is the message that the prophet Habakkuk saw.
LORD, how long must I call for help before you listen? I cry out to you, "Violence!" but you do not save.
Why do you make me see wrongdoing? Why do you put up with evil? Destruction and violence are all around me. There is fighting, and arguments break out.
So the law is powerless, and justice never wins. The wicked surround those who do right, so justice is twisted.
"Look at the nations and watch. You will be utterly amazed. I am going to do something in your lifetime that you would not believe, even if someone told you.
I am raising up the Babylonians, that cruel and fast-moving nation. They march across the whole earth to take over homes that are not theirs.
They are feared and terrifying. They make their own rules and answer to no one but themselves.
Their horses are faster than leopards and fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their horsemen gallop proudly ahead. They come from far away. They swoop down like an eagle rushing to eat its prey.
They all come ready for violence. Their armies push forward like a desert wind, and they gather prisoners like sand.
They make fun of kings and laugh at rulers. They laugh at every fortress, because they build dirt ramps up to them and capture them.
Then they sweep past like the wind and move on. But they are guilty, because their own strength is their god."
LORD, you have existed from the beginning. My God, my Holy One, we will not die. LORD, you have appointed the Babylonians to carry out your judgment. My Rock, you have sent them to punish us.

Your eyes are too pure to look at evil. You cannot put up with wrongdoing. So why do you put up with people who cannot be trusted? Why are you silent while the wicked swallow up those who are more righteous than they are?
You have made people like fish in the sea, like sea creatures that have no ruler.
The wicked enemy pulls all of them up with hooks. He catches them in his net and gathers them up in his fishing net. Then he celebrates and is glad.
So he offers sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his fishing net, because it gives him a life of luxury and the best food.
Will he keep on emptying his net and destroying nations without mercy?
